messages.author: dc15442c44d3793b
messages.subject: Failure of Interactive plotting
parts:
I am new to using Deducer under JGC. The first time that I loaded
Deducer the plot menue did not show up of JGR. I reinstalled Deducer
and iplot. The plot menue is now present on JGR. It displayes plot
builder, import templet and open plot. Below open plot there are a
list of the plots from plot builder. the interactive option is not
present. Does anybody have an idea what could cause this?

Thanks, Ron

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Failure of Interactive plotting
parts:
If you don't have the latest version of R (2.12.x), you get an older
version of deducer by default. You can either install from the source,
or upgrade your R. You can use sessionInfo() to find out what version
of deducer you are using. It should be 0.4-3.

ian
